title: Pot Presets
description: Adds preset Decorated Pots to the Creative Inventory
body: ![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/888f564d309e71d3fcf9290fb7a15c0d95f4b63a.png) **Have you ever needed a specific decorated pot in creative mode and had to craft one? Do you wish it was as simple as opening the inventory? Pot Presets makes it easier!** **Of course, it's impossible and impractical to add EVERY possible decorated pot into the creative inventory, but this mod gives you a total of 40!** The first 20 are 4 sides of the same sherd for every sherd in the game, and the second 20 are the front sherd (with the other 3 sides blank) for every sherd in the game! I hope you find this mod useful if you use it!
